secrets.name: SHOPIFY_FLAG_STORE
secrets.description: Your Shopify store URL, e.g. my-store.myshopify.com (or just the store prefix). Obtain from your Shopify admin URL.

secrets.name: SHOPIFY_CLI_THEME_TOKEN
secrets.description: A Shopify Theme Access token (from Shopify admin > Apps > Theme Access > Generate token) or a Shopify Admin API access token (from Shopify admin > Apps > Develop apps > your app > Admin API access token).

secrets.name: SHOPIFY_FLAG_STORE_PASSWORD
secrets.description: Optional: the storefront password if your store has password protection enabled (Shopify admin > Online Store > Preferences > Password protection). Leave blank if your storefront is not password-protected.
